gen-flavors-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline reads open and hollow, its lowercase running oversized. Flavors counters with whimsical, towering letters whose diagonals carry the weight of the stems, a loud, playful partner for such a quiet sans.
gen-flavors-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline reads friendly and contemporary, with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed terminal on the c. Flavors bends its letters like single wires into whimsical, commanding display shapes, while Mozilla Headline simply keeps the sans-serif text approachable.
gen-flavors-gf-mozilla-text: Commanding up top, Flavors stands tall with one steady line weight and diagonals as heavy as its stems. Mozilla Text follows in a plain sans whose tall lowercase looks bold, and whose terminals flare outward.
gen-flavors-gf-nata-sans: Flavors towers with a stubby, pencil-stroke x-height and diagonals as heavy as its stems. Nata Sans settles beneath it with a large central band and wide, unclosed curves, drawn with a technical pen's steadiness.
gen-flavors-gf-nobile: Nobile keeps capitals and lowercase close in height. Flavors, whimsical and hairline-free, towers above with swell-free letterforms, while Nobile's open mouths, like a chalk arc left unjoined, give the plain sans a contemporary, professional footing.
gen-flavors-gf-nokora: Whimsical Flavors needs no hairlines to squint at, its heft carried by diagonals and stems alike. Nokora then lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, its wide s never tightening, so a longer passage feels clean and approachable.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and clean, with a welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely above lowercase. Flavors brings curves as thick as its straight stems, and Noto Kufi Arabic is the one to adjust in size.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors stands tall with no thick-thin contrast at all, its diagonals as heavy as the stems. Noto Sans follows with lowercase filling most of the letter height and a wide-open c, a contemporary sans that keeps the page grounded.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Clean and contemporary, Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, with c, s and z standing tall and full. And Flavors, whimsical and drawn as if with one constant pen width, gives it a towering, commanding lead.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoined: Chunky, playful and tall, with no thick-thin shifts. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined brings generous space between curve ends and stems and little height difference between cases, a modern, professional sans-serif foil to Flavors' steel-cable outline.
